scope: Proposition 5.1 (Signed representative alternative) of the manuscript “Fourfold nonvanishing by minimal metrics and moving jets” (preprints/Fourfold-nonvanishing-by-minimal-metrics-and-moving-jets-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1946d50201ab1ae0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Y be a projective Q-factorial terminal fourfold such that KY is nef and κ(Y, KY ) = −∞. Suppose that there is a very general locus of Y through whose points every proper positive-dimensional subvariety is of general type on resolution. Let J be a rational Weil divisor, with coefficients of either sign, satisfying J ∼Q KY . Let p : W → Y be a projective log resolution, and let DW be a reduced simple normal crossings divisor containing the strict support of J and every p-exceptional divisor. Then KW + DW is big.
